implemented_controls.name: No Placeholder
implemented_controls.definition: Scaffolding, stubs, mocks, hard-coded success, or unfinished-marker-bound behavior must not masquerade as implemented capability.

implemented_controls.name: No Dead Path
implemented_controls.definition: Exposed or invoked statically provable paths must resolve to implemented behavior.

enforcement.basis: unbaselined verified-risk findings fail enforce mode

implemented_controls.name: No False Success
implemented_controls.definition: A system must not report success when required behavior materially failed or was not verified.

enforcement.basis: candidate findings require review before violation classification

implemented_controls.name: No Magic Configuration
implemented_controls.definition: Consequential operational configuration must be explicit, governed, and not hidden in code or accidental defaults.

enforcement.basis: candidate-only shadow detection; reviewed evidence required before stronger classification

defined_controls.name: No Hidden Coupling
defined_controls.definition: Material runtime dependencies must be explicit and inspectable rather than hidden coupling.

defined_controls.name: No Implicit State
defined_controls.definition: Material lifecycle state must be explicit rather than inferred from scattered side effects.

defined_controls.name: No Duplicate Source of Truth
defined_controls.definition: Authoritative facts must have one canonical owner, with derived copies carrying provenance and synchronization rules.

defined_controls.name: No Unrecoverable Mutation
defined_controls.definition: Consequential mutation must have rollback, compensation, versioning, or an explicit irreversible-action gate.

defined_controls.name: No Broken Referential Integrity
defined_controls.definition: Canonical identities and references must resolve without orphaning required relationships.

defined_controls.name: No Contract Violation
defined_controls.definition: Interfaces must satisfy declared schemas, types, invariants, versions, and compatibility contracts.

defined_controls.name: No Schema Drift
defined_controls.definition: Database, API, runtime, and documentation schema expectations must not silently diverge.

defined_controls.name: No Test-Evidence Substitution
defined_controls.definition: Passing lower-level tests must not substitute for required integration or live acceptance evidence.

defined_controls.name: No Unverified External Effect
defined_controls.definition: External effects must be verified against the external system before being represented as completed.

defined_controls.name: No Lost Auditability
defined_controls.definition: Material actions must preserve attributable, correlated, durable audit evidence.

defined_controls.name: No Ambiguous Authority
defined_controls.definition: Privileged actions must bind to explicit actor, authority, scope, and governing decision.

defined_controls.name: No Irreproducible Build
defined_controls.definition: Builds and deployments must identify their source revision, dependency/configuration class, and artifact identity.

defined_controls.name: No Configuration Promotion by Accident
defined_controls.definition: Environment/configuration promotion must be explicit and mechanically resistant to accidental crossing.

defined_controls.name: No Documentation Overclaim
defined_controls.definition: Documentation must not claim capability beyond verified implementation reality.

defined_controls.name: No Observability Blind Spot
defined_controls.definition: Material workflows must expose enough state to distinguish running, blocked, failed, completed, retried, or abandoned.

defined_controls.name: No Retry Without Control
defined_controls.definition: Retries must be bounded, authorized, observable, and idempotent or fenced where repeated mutation is possible.

defined_controls.name: No Unbounded Operation
defined_controls.definition: Long-running or external operations must have bounded lifetime, cancellation, lease, or watchdog semantics.

defined_controls.name: No Incomplete Cleanup
defined_controls.definition: Failed or cancelled operations must leave known recoverable state or explicit intentionally persistent residue.

defined_controls.name: No Evidence Disconnect
defined_controls.definition: Acceptance evidence must bind to the exact requirement, revision, build, environment, configuration, and observed result.

defined_controls.name: No Regression Concealment
defined_controls.definition: A control may not be satisfied by weakening or deleting the evidence, test, detector, or scope that revealed its violation.
